## Access and recovery

Open the live URL. On the target VM, user `ubuntu` has observer access in
`/home/ubuntu/.config/polyia/observer-access.env` (owner-only mode0600). Use its
read token in the UI; credentials are intentionally absent from this repository
and handoff. Operator credentials remain root-only in `/etc/polyia/runtime.env`.
Use the existing authorized host access to obtain them; do not paste them into
Git, issues, URLs or logs.

The machine interface is discovery `/.well-known/polyia.json` and authenticated
`/v1/state`, `/v1/checkpoints/cp-00000120`, `/v1/events`, `/v1/verify` and captured
blob routes. The installed `polyia.remote` client supports private durable
journals and exact-request recovery; see [client instructions](REMOTE_CLIENT.md).
The supported interpreter is `/opt/polyia/runtime/bin/python3`, not host Python3.10.

State: `/var/lib/polyia/state/ledger.sqlite3`; artifacts:
`/var/lib/polyia/artifacts`; consistent backups: `/var/lib/polyia/backups`.
Services: `polyia.service`, `polyia-tunnel.service`. Preserve their accounts,
root-only environment and unrelated existing VM services. Never initialize a new
ledger over this database. Resume research through acknowledged `resume_research`
guidance only after an owner request.

## Remaining work and limitations

Promotion/Plica, compiled multiport QBundles, and sealed research queues are
**design-only; implementation not started**. Their audited plans are retained in
[the promotion handoff](HANDOFF_PROMOTION_STATUS_2026-10-24.md),
[Q-Bundle plan](plans/qbundle-promotion-next.md), and
[lifecycle design/status](designs/experiment-lifecycle/STATUS.json).
All agents stopped before creating new runtime code for those tasks.

The remaining 190 mission obligations, broader chemistry/calculus/linguistic
corpus gates, independent witnesses, cross-machine studies, bounded evolution,
storage migration, application breadth and obligation-specific acceptance
adapters remain open. The University mandate is not activated. Infinity is IX;
VII/VIII remain open research charters. Book construction and the OpenClaw
reference decision are resolved in DEC-004/005, not new owner questions.

The HTTPS quick-tunnel hostname can change on tunnel restart. Permanent ingress
was attempted but OCI network-resource access was unavailable; no source-imposed
permanent-hostname or uptime threshold is invented. Browser/public-client checks
ran from the target VM, not an independent second host. GitHub Actions billing
blocked the original workflow; fresh local and independently fetched publication
checks are the evidence, not a green CI claim.
